verdict.rationale: Sentry's own Seer Agent is documented to take any natural-language question about an application and find the telemetry to answer it. The official MCP server also lets AI assistants search errors and analyze performance. However, no evidence shows the answer comes back as a real, inspectable query or a chart. Missing for 10: documented return of a generated query or chart from natural-language questions, details on which telemetry datasets are queryable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
It uses Sentry's rich context (issue details, tracing data, logs, and profiles) to help you troubleshoot and fix errors and performance issues faster.
Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects
